{{Youmay|the [[Species/Legends|species]] exhibition|"[[the zoo]]," a facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]}}
A '''zoo''' was a place where people kept different [[Species/Legends|species]] of animals of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for enjoyment and entertainment.

Notable zoos included [[Bollin Exotic Animal Emporium]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].
